last_review.summary: The implementation meets BE-002-01 acceptance criteria and architecture constraints. Changes are confined to allowed paths, provide compatible conversation/state types and an injectable process-local store, preserve immutable identity fields during updates, explicitly return undefined for unknown records, and introduce no persistence, HTTP, environment, credential, contract, or execution-layer changes. Deterministic build and full-tree layering verification both passed.

notes: No tests are executed by this loop; build and full-tree layering check are the deterministic gates.
V1 is entirely in-memory. A restart loses conversations, tasks, event buffers, pending approvals and auth contexts.
NoktosClient runs against an explicitly labelled mock; noktos-auth exposes no public controllers yet.
The Supabase access token never reaches a prompt, event, task payload, log or UI.
contracts/ is frozen at 1.0.0 and is a protected path; changing it is a human operation.
